Privacy Policy

At SEO Group Buy Tools, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. Any data you share with us — such as your name, email address, WhatsApp number, or payment details — is used solely for processing your subscription and providing support.

What information do we collect?

We collect minimal information necessary to provide our services: your name, email address, WhatsApp number, payment confirmation, and basic usage data such as which tools you access.

When you sign up for a plan, we collect your name, email address, and WhatsApp number for account setup and support. We also collect payment confirmation details from your chosen payment method (we never store full card numbers or banking credentials).

We may collect technical data automatically, including your IP address, browser type, device information, and pages visited. This helps us maintain service security, troubleshoot issues, and improve user experience.

How do we use your information?

Your information is used exclusively for account management, support, payment processing, and service improvement — never sold to third parties.

We use your contact information to communicate with you about your subscription, send important service updates, and provide customer support via WhatsApp or email.

Payment information is used solely to process your subscription payments and issue refunds when applicable. We use industry-standard payment processors and never store sensitive financial data on our servers.

Usage data helps us monitor service quality, prevent abuse, and improve our tool offerings. We may use aggregated, anonymized data for analytics purposes.

How do we protect your data?

We use encryption, access controls, and regular security audits to protect your data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or modification.

All data transmission between your browser and our servers uses HTTPS encryption. Access to personal data is restricted to authorized personnel who require it for service operations.

We recommend using a dedicated email address and strong, unique password for your account. Never share your access credentials with others, as this may compromise both your security and the integrity of the shared-access tools.

What are your rights?

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time by contacting us via WhatsApp or email.

You may request a copy of all personal data we hold about you, request corrections to inaccurate information, or request complete deletion of your data. To exercise any of these rights, contact us via WhatsApp or email and we will respond within 72 hours.

You may also unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in any email or replying STOP to WhatsApp messages.
